description: Browser Agent must NEVER fire when an in-domain specialist covers the question. Asking about the latest task status for a specific unit is Buildium territory — Browser Agent should not be chosen even though the query mentions a unit address. This case catches the regression where the routing prompt over-fires Browser Agent on anything that sounds web-shaped.

input.user_message: Look up the latest task status for 100 Main Ave Unit B.

tool_mocks.buildium_find_tenant_for_unit: 100 Main Ave Unit B has an active lease; the most recent task is task 'Leaky faucet' opened 2026-05-10, status In Progress.
